It appropriately does not treat the Idaho/Texas preliminary orders as final nationwide findings. The 6B.7 null is not converted into a finding. However, a bounded check for substantiated allegations, complaints, inspector-general findings, or litigation concerning partisan conditioning remains absent.","closed_system_silence":"Low risk: this is an open, highly scrutinized federal system with courts, GAO/OIG, surveys, and public administrative data. Silence nevertheless cannot establish the absence of localized or subnational misconduct.","duplicate_reporting":"Material duplication exists between the compact WEB-6B records and ledger WD001–WD018 versions of the same source-claim units; count only one version of each. Census press-release/report corroboration and agency releases based on the same administrative data are not independent confirmations. WEB-6B-C1-001 and WEB-6B-C1-002 are distinct claims from one GAO report, not independent source families; likewise WEB-6B-C1-004 and WEB-6B-C1-005 share one EPA OIG report.","favorable_and_adverse_search":"Yes at the chapter level: the notebook includes favorable implementation/institution-building material and adverse poverty, food-security, affordability, learning, access, oversight, and legal-constraint material. No documented targeted adverse/favorable search establishes the 6B.7 political-conditionality null, so that lens remains incompletely tested.","missing_source_type":"Independent beneficiary- or project-level implementation evaluation is missing for first-year water delivery and PACT outcomes; a precise underlying #WeCount report locator is also needed. For 6B.7, the needed source type is a bounded independent complaint, inspector-general, enforcement, or litigation review rather than institutional-structure inference.","official_claim_independence":"Partly adequate: GAO/OIG, courts, an independent household survey, a peer-reviewed study, KFF, and provider data check several official claims. But several favorable delivery claims remain chiefly official administrative or announcement evidence, especially Marketplace selections, water allocations, and PACT initial uptake; they should not be read as independently verified beneficiary outcomes.","open_system_complaint_volume":"Open-system litigation, audits, survey reporting, and post-Dobbs complaints can make particular failures highly visible and are not prevalence estimates. The notebook generally qualifies geographic scope and causation, but does not systematically distinguish isolated administrative failures from national prevalence.","population_exposure_authority_baseline_shocks":"Substantially addressed. The orientation and records distinguish federal from state/local authority, inherited ACA/ARP/COVID baselines, the exceptional 2021 relief comparison, inflation, Omicron, Ukraine-related price pressure, Dobbs, courts, and decentralized delivery. Group and geographic exposure is covered for several domains, though water completion, childcare, sanitation, and some disability-service outcomes remain thin.","supporting_evidence_ids":["WD001","WD002","WD005","WD006","WD007","WD008","WD009","WD010","WD011","WD012","WD013","WD014","WD015","WD016","WD017","WD018","WEB-6B-C1-001","WEB-6B-C1-002","WEB-6B-C1-004","WEB-6B-C1-005","WEB-6B-C1-007","WEB-6B-C1-008","WEB-6B-C1-010","WEB-6B-C1-011"],"unresolved_risks":["The underlying source URL for WEB-6B-C1-009 is a report index rather than the precise report locator; recoverable extraction is required before relying on that claim.","WEB-6B-C1-004 and WEB-6B-C1-005 establish oversight-system weaknesses with substantial pre-BIL history, not first-year 2022 project completion or household water-quality outcomes.","PACT evidence establishes enactment, claims, screenings, and an early control gap more clearly than completed 2022 benefits, care access, or health outcomes.","The 6B.7 conclusion rests largely on institutional design and absence of substantiated national allegations; it lacks a documented bounded contrary-evidence search.","The announced revision to 2019–2024 supplemental-poverty estimates leaves WD001 provisional; this is an external publication blocker, not adverse evidence."]},"chapter_id":"6B","defensible_evidence_estimate":29,"independent_source_family_estimate":16,"missing_themes":["6B.2: independently verified first-year water-project completion/beneficiary access and fuller childcare or sanitation access evidence.","6B.3: precise, directly located post-Dobbs access evidence and remaining disability-service distribution evidence.","6B.4: independent assessment of PACT and water implementation controls during 2022 beyond agency-reported uptake or allocations.","6B.5: evidence of whether identified water/PACT/ESSER control weaknesses were corrected or materially affected service delivery in the target period.","6B.7: bounded independent check for substantiated national political-conditionality allegations, findings, complaints, or enforcement actions.","6B.9: evidence on durability beyond enactment/allocation, particularly water completion and locally sustained ESSER capacity.","6B.10: completed-project and beneficiary-outcome evidence for water and PACT, rather than inputs, claims, screenings, or allocations."],"substantive_issues":["The same core source-claim units appear under compact WEB-6B IDs and ledger WD IDs. These are duplicate copies and must not be counted twice; one stable global record per fact should remain with many-to-many lens mappings.","WEB-6B-C1-009 uses a reports/index URL as the source URL despite naming a particular report. Recover the direct report URL before treating it as a defensible source-claim unit.","Several favorable official implementation records are appropriately qualified but still lack independent outcome checks; their administrative totals support activity or enrollment, not effective access, completed infrastructure, or beneficiary outcomes.","WD012 chiefly evaluates 2021 vaccine-equity implementation. It is usable only as inherited/Biden-era context as labelled, not as direct evidence of 2022 delivery."]}],"global_findings":["The notebook is balanced and unusually explicit about shared authority, baselines, shocks, temporal limits, and contrary evidence; no score-bearing language appears.","After excluding duplicate WEB/WD copies and the imprecisely located #WeCount record, the chapter exceeds the minimum unit and independent-family thresholds, but evidence adequacy is not complete for the stated selected lenses.","A bounded continuation can materially improve the dossier through direct #WeCount extraction, independent completed-water/beneficiary evidence, 2022 PACT delivery evidence, and a documented 6B.7 contrary-evidence search.
